summary.name: PhotoRestore.ai
summary.one_liner: PhotoRestore.ai is a web-based AI tool that restores old, faded, scratched, torn, or stained photos and colorizes black-and-white images.
use_cases: Restoring faded or yellowed family photos
Removing scratches, creases and stains from scanned prints
Batch restoration for photo studios or archives
Creating digital archives of old prints
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI service that uploads a scanned photo and automatically fixes scratches, sharpens details, and colorizes the image, then lets you preview and download an HD result. It says the tool fills in tears, creases, mold and stains by analyzing surrounding pixels, and that its colorization is based on era, lighting and texture rather than simple tinting. It lists separate tools for faded photos, scratches, stains, torn photos and general restoration. Supported input formats named are JPG, PNG and WEBP.
notable: Context-aware filling for tears, creases, mold and stains
Separate specialized tools for scratches, stains, tears and fading
Credit-based packs at $1.00 down to $0.37 per photo, with credits that never expire on larger packs
Free trial with no sign-up or credit card stated
caveats: Paid credit packs are required beyond the free trial; the page does not detail free-trial limits
Page lists a Starter Pack valid for 12 months, while higher packs state credits never expire
Some listed features such as priority support and HD downloads are tied to paid packs
